findings.claim: With v2 the default, rollback by reinstalling the previous release no longer works without data repair, which the design's Platform section says it does ('Rollback: an environment flag ..., a config flip ... or a reinstall, with no data repair'). A review drafted under the default can hold director_funding, which the previous release cannot read back. The diff hides this in the test by drafting under CMA_RULESET=v1 instead of the default. The README documents the workaround, but the design line was not updated.
findings.repro: Draft a pending review with `cma run examples/cafe_stretched.csv --checkpoint-db db --thread t` with CMA_RULESET unset (T00210 becomes director_funding), install the previous wheel, then run `cma resume t --checkpoint-db db`. The previous release cannot read the director_funding category back, which tests/test_p7_history.py:158-160 itself records. Before this diff the same test passed under the default.
